The '''Brodo Asogi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Perinn sector/Legends|Perinn sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Brodo Asogi]].
